title: Imperative 3: The -ь Command and the Stress Test (-и or -ь)
titleRussian: Повелительное наклонение 3: форма на -ь и проверка ударением (-и или -ь)
description: How to choose between -и and -ь on a consonant-stem command: stressed 1sg ending gives -и (говори), unstressed gives -ь (готовь, забудь, встань). A few cluster and irregular forms (помни, ешь, дай) are exceptions.
descriptionRussian: Как выбрать между -и и -ь у глаголов с основой на согласный: ударное окончание 1 л. ед. ч. даёт -и (говори), безударное даёт -ь (готовь, забудь, встань). Несколько форм (помни, ешь, дай) — исключения.
intro: The other half of the test. Stem stress in the я-form gives you a soft sign instead of the vowel you learned last lesson, so the two lessons together let you predict any consonant-stem command from how the verb sounds. There is one override worth memorizing: a stem ending in two consonants ignores the test. And two commands are simply irregular.
rules: On a consonant stem, look at the я form: stress on the ending gives -и (говорю́ → говори), stress on the stem gives -ь (забу́ду → забудь).
Build the -ь form from the они form: drop the ending, then add the soft sign -ь, as in готовят → готовь, встанут → встань, забудут → забудь.
When the stem ends in two consonants together, use -и even with stem stress: помнить (я по́мню) → помни, not помнь.
Two commands are special and just memorised: есть → ешь, дать → дай.
examples: Готовь ужин! (Make dinner!) я гото́влю is stem-stressed, so the command ends in -ь.
Забудь об этом! (Forget about it!) я забу́ду is stem-stressed → забудь.
Встань, пожалуйста. (Stand up, please.) я вста́ну is stem-stressed → встань.
Говори громче! (Speak louder!) я говорю́ is end-stressed → говори, with -и.
Помни о встрече. (Remember the meeting.) stem ends in -мн (two consonants), so -и: помни.
Ешь суп, пока горячий. (Eat the soup while it is hot.) есть has the special command ешь.

tables.title: Stress Test: -и or -ь on a Consonant Stem

items.hint: Читать has a vowel stem чита-. Which suffix goes after a vowel?
items.explanation: Quick recap before today's new skill: читать has a vowel stem (чита-, from 3pl читают), and a vowel stem always takes -й: читай. The -и and -ь choice you drill today only applies to consonant stems. After a vowel there is no choice: it is always -й.

items.promptEnglish: Make dinner, the guests will arrive soon!
items.hint: The я form is гото́влю. Is the stress on the ending or on the stem?
items.explanation: The я form гото́влю is stressed on the stem (the о of готов-), so the command takes -ь: готовь. Готови with -и would be wrong because -и is only for end-stressed verbs like говори (говорю́).

items.promptEnglish: Forget about it, everything is fine now.
items.hint: The я form забу́ду is stressed on the stem. Stem stress gives which ending?
items.explanation: The я form забу́ду is stem-stressed (stress on забу-), so the command takes -ь: забудь. Забуди with -и would only fit an end-stressed verb.

items.promptEnglish: Stand up, please, when the teacher comes in.
items.hint: The я form вста́ну is stem-stressed. Stem stress → -ь.
items.explanation: The я form вста́ну is stressed on the stem (вста-), so the command takes -ь: встань. Встани with -и would be wrong, because that ending is reserved for end-stressed verbs like иди (иду́).

items.promptEnglish: Speak louder, I can't hear well!
items.hint: The я form говорю́ is stressed on the ending. End stress → -и.
items.explanation: The я form говорю́ is stressed on the ending, so the command takes -и: говори. Говорь with -ь would be wrong because -ь is only for stem-stressed verbs like готовь. The stress of the я form is the test that separates the two.

items.promptEnglish: Remember about our meeting on Friday.
items.hint: The я form по́мню is stem-stressed, but the stem ends in two consonants (-мн).
items.explanation: По́мню is stem-stressed, so you might expect -ь. But the stem помн- ends in two consonants together, and -ь would be hard to say, so the command uses -и: помни (not помнь). This is the cluster exception.

blanks: _____ ужин, я очень голодный! (Make dinner, I'm very hungry!)
_____ суп, пока он горячий. (Eat the soup while it's hot.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Готовить: the я form гото́влю is stem-stressed, so the command takes -ь → готовь (not готови, which is for end-stressed verbs). Есть is a special verb with the memorised command ешь (not еши).

errorCorrection.explanation: The я form отве́чу is stressed on the stem, so the command takes -ь: ответь. Ответи uses -и, which belongs to end-stressed verbs like говори (говорю́); the stress test is what separates them.

errorCorrection.sentence: Остави книгу на столе, я возьму её позже.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Leave the book on the table; I'll take it later.
errorCorrection.explanation: The я form оста́влю is stem-stressed, so the command takes the soft sign -ь: оставь. Остави with -и would only fit a verb whose я form is end-stressed.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Believe me, I am telling the truth.
errorCorrection.explanation: The я form ве́рю is stem-stressed, so the command takes -ь: верь. Вери uses the end-stressed ending -и, which does not fit this verb.

errorCorrection.sentence: Чисть зубы два раза в день.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Brush your teeth twice a day.
errorCorrection.explanation: Чи́щу is stem-stressed, which usually points to -ь, but the stem чист- ends in two consonants together, so the command uses -и instead: чисти. The -ь would be too hard to pronounce after the cluster, the same escape hatch as помни.

minimalPairs.explanation: Готовить has the stem-stressed я form гото́влю, so the command takes -ь: готовь. Готови with -и would only fit an end-stressed verb like говори. Stem stress → -ь.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Speak louder, you can't be heard!
minimalPairs.explanation: Говорить has the end-stressed я form говорю́, so the command takes -и: говори. Говорь with -ь would only fit a stem-stressed verb like готовь. End stress → -и.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Remember about the meeting, it's important.
minimalPairs.explanation: По́мню is stem-stressed, but the stem помн- ends in two consonants, so the soft -ь is replaced by -и: помни. The cluster makes помнь hard to say, so the language uses -и instead.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each command by the ending it takes. Use the stress of the я form (and watch for the cluster exception помни).

sentenceBuilding.hint: я form забу́ду is stem-stressed → command ends in -ь.
я form гото́влю is stem-stressed → command ends in -ь.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Stand up and open the window.
sentenceBuilding.hint: встать: я form вста́ну is stem-stressed → -ь. открыть has a vowel stem → -й.
по́мню is stem-stressed, but the stem ends in two consonants → -и.

reviewVocab.definition: the -ь command: used when the я form is stressed on the stem (готовь, забудь, встань, ставь). The -ь is a soft sign that adds no sound.
reviewVocab.example: У глагола забыть форма я (забу́ду) ударная на основе, поэтому повеление — забудь.

reviewVocab.definition: the stress test: a consonant-stem command takes -и if the я form is end-stressed (говорю́ → говори) and -ь if it is stem-stressed (гото́влю → готовь)
reviewVocab.example: Говорю́ ударно на окончании — значит говори; гото́влю ударно на основе — значит готовь.

reviewVocab.definition: three commands that break the simple pattern: помни (stem ends in two consonants, so -и not -ь), and the special forms ешь (from есть) and дай (from дать)
reviewVocab.example: Ешь суп, помни о встрече и дай мне ручку.
